claims.quote: The indicator I(y=i) selects the term for the observed class from the K possible classes, so the sum reduces to ln(1/p_y); training minimizes the average of this quantity over the labeled set.
The network is penalized when it gives the correct class a small probability: assigning probability 0.9 to the true class gives a small loss, while assigning 0.1 gives a much larger one.
